remoteAccessPasswordHint: The password is required to sign in from a browser and is stored hashed on this machine.
remoteAccessEnableHint: Serve this workbench to browsers on your network.
remoteAccessSecurityHint: Remote traffic is plain HTTP on your local network. Only enable it on networks you trust.
remoteAccessExternalHint: For access away from home, run this through your own VPN or tunnel (e.g. Tailscale, WireGuard, cloudflared) — Kun does not provide a public relay.
remoteAccessQrHint: Scan with a phone or tablet on the same network
remoteAccessPasswordRequired: Set a password first — it protects Remote on your network.
remoteAccessStopToChange: Stop Remote to change listen settings.
remoteAccessTailscaleHint: Check whether Tailscale is set up on this host to reach Kun from outside your LAN.
remoteAccessTailscaleFound: Tailscale is connected — devices on your tailnet can use this address.
remoteAccessTailscaleInstalled: Tailscale is installed but not connected. Open Tailscale and connect, then detect again.
remoteAccessTailscaleMissing: Tailscale was not detected on this host.
